Class Http11AprProtocol

java.lang.Object
org.apache.coyote.AbstractProtocol<Long>
org.apache.coyote.http11.AbstractHttp11Protocol<Long>
org.apache.coyote.http11.Http11AprProtocol
All Implemented Interfaces:
MBeanRegistration, ProtocolHandler
@Deprecated public class Http11AprProtocol extends AbstractHttp11Protocol<Long>
Deprecated.
The APR/Native Connector will be removed in Tomcat 9.1.x onwards and has been removed from Tomcat 10.1.x onwards.
HTTP/1.1 protocol implementation using APR/native.
